mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_account (account_no, customer_id, balance) VALUES (#{accountNo}, #{customerId}, 0.00)
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_no, customer_id, balance, created_at FROM bank_account WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
SELECT id, account_no, customer_id, balance, created_at FROM bank_account WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, account_no, customer_id, balance, created_at FROM bank_account WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_account SET balance = #{balance} WHERE id = #{id}
